subject: Oceanography
title: Ocean Sediment Cores
description: A short lesson to help you apply Ocean Sediment Cores.

hook.text: A tube of mud from the ocean floor can tell you Earth's climate history for millions of years.

buildup.text: Scientists drill cores from deep-sea sediments—each layer records conditions when it settled.

discovery.text: Foraminifera shells in the sediment record oxygen isotope ratios—revealing past temperatures and ice volumes.

twist.text: These cores revealed that ice ages cycle every 100,000 years—matching Earth's orbital wobbles (Milankovitch cycles).

climax.text: Sediment records show that rapid warming has caused mass extinctions before—the PETM, 56 million years ago.

punchline.text: The ocean floor remembers every climate shift—written in mud and shells.

quiz.question: What do ocean sediment cores reveal?
options: Past temperatures and ice volumes from shell chemistry
The age of the ocean itself
